name: Improve Delegation & Cross-Agent Workflow
description: Evidence-driven improvement of delegation governance, cross-agent context sharing, delegation instruction quality, result handling, and multi-agent coordination patterns.

steps.title: Audit delegation health
steps.description: Query recent missions involving delegations. For each delegation: count round-trips, measure time from delegation sent to result received, check if the delegate had to re-plan (indicates vague instruction), check for ENOENT errors (cross-agent context failure), check for concurrent delegation violations (multiple active delegations to same target), count cancelled delegations (delegation storm indicator). Read checkpoint-executor delegation guard logs for blocked/bypassed events.
steps.accept_criteria: Delegation health metrics: average round-trips, re-plan rate at delegate, ENOENT rate, concurrent violations, cancellation rate, guard bypass rate. Top 3 delegation issues ranked by impact.

steps.title: Diagnose delegation instruction quality
steps.description: For delegations where the delegate had to re-plan: read the original delegation instruction. Check against the 5-field specificity standard: (1) what to do — specific action, not a goal, (2) input files — by Drive ID or name, (3) specific changes — what to modify, (4) output location — where to put results, (5) acceptance criteria — how to verify. Score each delegation 0-5. Delegations scoring <3 are too vague.
steps.accept_criteria: Delegation quality scores. List of vague delegations with the specific missing fields.

steps.title: Diagnose cross-agent context failures
steps.description: For ENOENT errors: trace the file reference. Was the file on the delegator's VM only? Was it published to Drive before delegating? Check if the checkpoint-executor's pre-delegation artifact publish (if implemented) fired correctly. If not implemented: document the gap.
steps.accept_criteria: Each ENOENT traced to root cause. Pre-delegation publish status documented.

steps.title: Fix delegation governance
steps.description: Based on findings: (a) If concurrent guard is bypassed — fix the Firestore query path or index. (b) If delegation instructions are vague — update the delegating agent's cortex SOUL_APPEND with specificity requirements (this is an Organ SOULs change — create a separate commit). (c) If cross-agent context is failing — implement or fix the pre-delegation artifact publish in checkpoint-executor (this is a Daemons change — create a separate commit). (d) If delegation timeout is missing — add timeout logic to the envelope scan. Each fix goes in its own module's commit.
steps.accept_criteria: Each fix in the correct module. No cross-module changes in a single commit.

steps.title: Test delegation end-to-end
steps.description: Send a mission that requires delegation (e.g., product-architect delegating design work to designer). Monitor the full lifecycle: delegation sent → delegate receives → delegate executes → result returned → delegator resumes. Verify: instruction is specific (score ≥3), no ENOENT, no concurrent violations, result received within timeout, delegator correctly processes the result.
steps.accept_criteria: Delegation round-trip completes. Instruction quality ≥3. Zero ENOENT. Zero guard violations. Result processed correctly.
